boundaries: Introduction is not execution, copying permission, redistribution approval, a commercial-use grant or a security endorsement
Describe license restrictions, unavailable product source and uncertain reuse rights accurately; do not relabel them as permissive open source
Keep the maintainer's own repositories out of scope and leave their tabs untouched
No upstream execution, dependency installation, model/data downloads, private harness changes or historical HTML operations
Retain prior research and proposal receipts as history; do not falsify their earlier state
Only close each target after its complete page passes gates and has its own local commit
This decision does not grant push, PR, merge, cleanup or remote-publication authorization
verification_required: Complete source-backed bilingual pages under the current schema
Real licensing and source-availability disclosures in both language mirrors
Generated flow, mechanism and health artifacts with authenticated source evidence
Per-repository gates and exact-pair quality checks
Independent semantic review and committed-byte binding
Target-only tab closure verification and preserved own/non-target tabs
Final old-content regression and full-batch verification
rollback: Keep the baseline and all prior commits; any correction or rollback is a separate reviewed commit, never a reset or deletion of prior work
original_summary_status: The original ignored v10 report is still unavailable. This promotion does not claim it was restored, updated or replaced.
